question: The Rongker festival is celebrated by the Karbi tribe of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Assam.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **Rongker festival**__ is __**celebrated**__ by the __**Karbi tribe of Assam**__.

 __
 
• The **Karbis **of **Assam **celebrate **Rongker**, a wintertime festival of fun, every year.
 
• It is also known as **Dehal **in **Dumra Longri**, which includes the **Ri-Bhoi **district of **Meghalaya **and the **Kamrup Metropolitan **district of **Assam**.
 
• It is practised to **please **the **local deities**, who are seen as protectors of the community and responsible for the **crop harvest**, as well as to **banish **all **bad luck.**
 
• The celebration does have a set time, though it is typically celebrated on **February 5 **at the start of the **Karbi New Year**.
 
• Depending totally on their **convenience**, **different villages **may observe it at **various times**.
 
• **Three** **days **are dedicated to the celebration. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information:__

 
• To cover the costs of the rites, every community gives **financially **and in **kind**.
 
• **Donations **are also **gathered **from **nearby communities**.
 
• The celebration is broken into **four main sections**:
 
• **Sadi:**
 
 
• **All gods** are asked to **participate **in this procedure.
 
 
 
• **Karkli:**
 
 
• In this place, there are **two ways **to **worship **the deities: **Kibo-kaba, **which involves feeding the gods, and **Koia-abida,** which involves giving the gods areca nuts and betel leaves.
 
• The celebration is attended by the **entire human race.**
 
 
 
• **Rongphu-Rongling-Kangthin:**
 
 
• It is also known as the **Ajo-Rongker **and is presented on the second day's evening.
 
• In this section, **dancing **is used to **ward **off **evil spirits **from the lower to the upper part of the hamlet. 
 
 
 
• **Rongker Langhe:**​
 
 
• This marks the **culmination **of the festival, which is observed on the **third day **of the celebration.
 
• To stop **tigers **from **attacking**, it is conducted next to a **ghat **by building an altar and offering a cock to the tiger god **Arnam-teke.**
